sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:64

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:64:1
items.html: The vessel of Keter grew and extended until opposite the place of the end of all of Tifferet: This is afterward, when the records of the Gevurot of Daat also rose to it, as written below in the words of the ARI, for then a coupling was made anew upon the Hassadim and Gevurot of Daat, and then the vessels from the Chazeh [chest] downward grew, as written before us.
